invariants.rationale: Parallelism should be positive and data should be non-null for parallel processing to be meaningful.
The mapToPairFunc is required to transform items and must not be null.
A non-null reduceFunc is necessary to combine grouped values.
It is common that parallelism does not exceed the size of the data list when the list is non-empty.

invariants.expression: data != null && parallelism > 0 ? data.size() >= parallelism : true
invariants.rationale: If processing in parallel, there should be at least as many data elements as the level of parallelism.
